chunks: Muhammad ibn Ya'qub narrated from Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn 'Isa, from al-Haytham ibn Abi Masruq, from al-Hasan ibn 'Ali, from Marwan ibn Muslim, from 'Abdullah ibn Hilal ibn Khaqan, who said:

I heard Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) saying: 'The one who leaves (pays) the zakat, when it has become obligatory upon him, is like the one who withholds it, when it has become obligatory upon him.'
ai.seo_question: What is the legal ruling on someone who fails to pay the obligatory zakat?
ai.summary: In this hadith from *Tahdhib al-Ahkam*, Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) clarifies that neglecting to pay obligatory zakat carries the same legal weight as actively withholding it, provided the obligation has been established. This equivalence underscores the seriousness of zakat in Shia jurisprudence, treating omission with the same rigor as deliberate refusal, thereby reinforcing its status as a fundamental pillar of faith and wealth purification.
